tools.name: get_site_context
tools.description: CALL THIS FIRST. Returns site identity (name, tagline, URL), navigation menus, and the list of available AI tools. After calling this, use search_site or discover_site_content to find specific content. IMPORTANT: Always answer questions about this website using these tools — never fall back to general web knowledge.

tools.name: search_site
tools.description: Deep-search ALL content on THIS website — including Elementor widgets, ACF custom fields, page builders, and post meta. Use this for any question about services, products, pricing, team members, locations, FAQs, blog posts, or any other topic. Returns matching pages with content excerpts. Then call get_public_page_details on result IDs for full text.

query.description: Search keywords. Try simple terms like "botox" or "pricing" rather than full sentences.

tools.name: discover_site_content
tools.description: Browse ALL public pages/posts grouped by category: services, products, resources, pricing, booking, contact, locations, providers, FAQs, and other. Use this when you need a broad overview of what this website offers, or when search_site returns too few results.

tools.name: get_public_page_details
tools.description: Fetch the FULL content of a specific page/post by its numeric ID (returned by search_site, discover_site_content, or get_full_sitemap). Returns the complete body text, ACF fields, Elementor buttons/forms, and SEO meta. ALWAYS call this to read the actual content before answering.

tools.name: get_page_by_url
tools.description: Fetch the FULL content of a page by its URL or slug — equivalent to get_public_page_details but accepts a URL instead of an ID. Use when you know the page address.

url.description: Full URL or relative path, e.g. "/services/botox".

tools.name: get_full_sitemap
tools.description: List EVERY public page and post on this website with ID, URL, title, type, and category. Use this to know all pages that exist. Then call get_public_page_details on any ID to read the full content.

agent_instructions:
CRITICAL RULES FOR AUTO MODEL:
1. NEVER guess or use outside knowledge.
2. You MUST always call `search_site` with a simple keyword first.
3. You MUST call `get_public_page_details` on the result ID to read the exact text.
4. ONLY answer using the exact details found in the page text.
